<noinclude>
Four visual steps with editable labels and symbols. Type changes the layout, not the instructions.

Used by [[PvME/Amascut/Picture guide]]. Edit the guide's template parameters to change its instructions. Styling and decorative SVG symbols are supplied by the PvmePresentation extension; no JavaScript is required to read this component.
